target_customer: Large enterprises, first finance and accounting teams at SaaS companies, now enterprise AI transformation teams
problem: Companies could not see how work actually gets done, which made contract review and later AI automation slow and manual.
product_category: Enterprise AI, contract review then process discovery (Company Brain)

founders.name: Andrew Antos
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch 2018 says he reviewed contracts after law school and found it mind-numbing.

founders.name: Nischal Nadhamuni
founders.background_notes: Met Antos in a 2016 MIT entrepreneurship class per TechCrunch. Education not stated.

competitors.name: Kira Systems
competitors.what: Machine learning contract analysis, strong in M&A diligence

competitors.name: Luminance
competitors.what: AI document review for legal teams

technical_complexity.rationale: Natural language processing for contract review in 2018 required training models on messy documents with a small team. The later screen-based process discovery adds computer vision and agent building.

defensibility.rationale: Contract review had five or more funded rivals by early 2018. Enterprise integrations add switching costs later, not at founding.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals persisted in legal AI. Klarity moved to finance document review and then to enterprise process discovery, avoiding direct head to head with legal incumbents.

market_need_then: At the 2018 TechCrunch profile, 14 companies were using the first version and 4 were paying, including a major private equity fund. Founder cites manual contract review as painful.

branding.domain_note: Used klarity.ai; the legacy klarity.ai URLs now redirect to within.ai.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short, direct and confident; lines like 'Transform from Within' and 'Discover. Define. Deliver.'

rebrands.why: Reason and exact date not found; YC page lists 'Within (formerly Klarity)'

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found. The Klarity name was spelled like several unrelated companies, and the later rename suggests the old name did not fit the new positioning.

pivots.to: Automating document and data review for finance and accounting at SaaS companies
pivots.why: Company says it served 50 plus large SaaS companies in finance and accounting; date of the shift not stated

pivots.to: Company Brain: map how work is done and reallocate between people and agents
pivots.why: AI agents created demand for organizational context; exact date not stated

outcome_analysis: Klarity began in 2018 as contract review automation in a crowded legal AI field, then pivoted toward finance and later enterprise work discovery for AI agents. It raised an 18 million Series A in January 2022 and a 70 million Series B in June 2024, bringing the total to about 90 million, and renamed to Within. It is active with over 100 staff.
notes: Series A of 18 million is from the TechCrunch headline linked on the YC page and a SiliconANGLE summary; another summary says 15 million; lead investor not verified from a primary source. Series B date inferred from June 2024 coverage; the company post gives no date. Competitor list taken from a Law.com article dated February 2018, via a search summary of that article. The YC page may list founding in 2017 but one profile says S17; TechCrunch confirms Summer 2018.
